sentences.text: Health visitor Bethan Lloyd (S1) stated she spoke with Kayleigh Morris (S2) on the phone on Friday.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated the household is messy and she has been 'a bit mad'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed the presence of a twelve-day-old baby named Ruby.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated she is breastfeeding mostly but provides one bottle of formula at night because she is tired.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated Ruby feeds every two to two and a half hours in the day, sometimes wanting to feed all evening.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Ruby has six or seven wet nappies.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated she is physically alright but her stitches are still sore.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) described her mood as 'up and down' and stated she cries a lot.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated her sister believes crying a lot is normal.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) denied being hurt or made to feel frightened by anyone at home, except for one instance where Dean pushed her into a wardrobe door during an argument.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated Dean has pushed her three or four times since the summer.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) disclosed that in August, when she was approximately thirty weeks pregnant, Dean punched her in the stomach.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated she went to the hospital the day after the punching because the baby was not moving much, but the baby was fine; she told the hospital she had fallen.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed the punching incident happened only once.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated Dean checks her phone every night and goes through all her messages.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated Dean gets angry if she messages someone he does not like.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated Dean does not allow her to see her mother, calling her a 'bad influence'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated she last saw her mother in September, before Ruby was born, and her mother has not met Ruby.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) denied Dean ever hurting or being rough with Ruby.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated she feels safe at home today because Dean is at work until three o'clock.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated she is at home with Ruby's father, Dean, who works early shifts at a warehouse and is back at home around three o'clock.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) described the relationship with Dean as 'fine' and 'normal' but noted it is 'bit tense with no sleep'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated Dean deals with the money and she has applied for child benefit but does not have her own bank card.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed Ruby's birth was registered last Tuesday.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated her GP is Dr Anand.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated her six-week check is due around the eighth of January.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) provided her sister's contact number (starting with 77) for the GP and Women's Aid referral.
Bethan Lloyd (S1) agreed to make a Women's Aid referral today, with the worker to call Kirsty's phone by Friday.
Bethan Lloyd (S1) agreed to speak to the safeguarding lead today and inform Dr Anand.
Bethan Lloyd (S1) scheduled a return visit on Thursday the third of December at eleven o'clock.
